in_sanskrit.name: Nithesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace, Favor
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nithesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Nithesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nidhi' which means 'treasury' and 'Ish' which means 'God'. This name signifies the divine grace and favor bestowed upon an individual by the gods.
